Contact support

Email forestoceanlife@gmail.com. Please include your app version, iOS version, what you were trying to do, and the error message if there is one.

Use fictional examples where possible. Remove private details from screenshots. We will never ask for your Apple password, API key, or verification code.

Email support

Common questions

A reply did not finish

Check your internet connection. If the conversation offers Retry, use it to check and retry the same request. The AI service can be temporarily unavailable or reach its usage limit. Avoid repeatedly sending the same message as a new request.

Saved information and privacy controls remain available when only AI generation is unavailable. If the whole service is unreachable, reconnect first.

Change or forget a memory

Open You → Memories, select the detail, then correct it or choose Forget this memory. To stop future learning and use across conversations, turn memory off in You → Privacy.

Forgetting a memory does not remove the original conversation. You can delete that separately from its conversation options.

Find a previous conversation

Open History and choose a conversation. Temporary chats do not appear there. Check that you are using the same account.

Understand temporary chat

Temporary chats are not saved in the app’s history or memory database. They still require AI permission and are processed through our service and Anthropic. Provider retention is explained in the privacy policy.

Connect or recover an account

You → Account recovery contains the Apple connection and recovery controls. Use the same Apple account you originally connected. Guest content is not automatically merged with another account.

Apple recovery is still being verified on physical devices during this beta. Before deleting the app, check your connection status and keep a separate copy of anything important. Contact support if you are unsure. We cannot restore an unlinked guest account by email alone.

Ask Dharma has no sources yet

The beta’s source collection may be empty. The app should say when it cannot provide a source-supported answer. It should not present a made-up quotation as scripture. You can report an inaccurate attribution by email using a short, redacted excerpt.

Delete your data

Open You → Privacy → Delete all my data and confirm the request. When accepted, your account closes to new activity and cleanup is queued. Provider records and any backup copies follow their separate retention arrangements.

If you cannot access the app, email support with a deletion request. We will need to verify your account before acting on it. Read more about retention and deletion.

Give beta feedback

You can send feedback through TestFlight or email support. Describe the steps that led to the problem and whether it happens again. Check screenshots for private information before sharing them.

This beta is for invited development testers. App Store distribution in EU countries is not planned for this release.

When you need immediate help

Buddha Chat offers AI-generated reflection. It is not monitored as an emergency channel and does not provide medical treatment, therapy, or professional advice. If someone is in immediate danger, contact local emergency services or a trusted person who can help now.
